21. Guidelines for fixation of pay of candidates working in Public Sector Undertakings, etc., on their appointment as direct recruits on or after 1-1-2016.Pay shall be fixed at a stage in the Level of the post so that the pay and Dearness Allowance as admissible in the Government, protects the pay and Dearness Allowance drawn in the PSU, etc. If there is no such stage in the post, the pay shall be fixed at the stage next below that pay.
